title: Plasmodium: explore the organism guide
description: Browse the Plasmodium guide, explore the cell diagram and find available general image-analysis workflows.
objectives: Open the page from Home and find its main controls.
Identify the available inputs, actions and outputs.
Choose the next available analysis or reference.
prerequisite: Open spaCR Home. No input files are needed for the guide. The Plasmodium-specific assay tiles currently show Coming soon.

scenes.narration: Plasmodium has a guide of its own. From Home, choose Plasmodium to browse the organism, its cell compartments and the assays planned for it.
The information pane tells the parasite's story in sections, from the blood stage and the liver stage to motility. Drag the divider for more room beside the module tiles.
On the apicomplexan diagram, hover over a compartment to read what it is. Select several to highlight them together, and Clear components brings the view back.

The assay tiles are still marked Coming soon and can't be opened yet, but their descriptions show what each will measure. To analyse Plasmodium images today, go back Home and open Mask or Measure with your own images and suitable channel settings.
For deeper reading, the PlasmoDB and UniProt links open organism resources in your browser. Nothing here needs a dataset or a Run, and the guide writes no files.
